_doc: causeways: stepping stones Dressing lays (with our own flora; --flora-kit keeps the kit's): a line 'from' 'to' (x, z),
'rows' (offsets across it, m), about 'step' m apart along a row (each step 0.65-1.35 of it), nudged up to 'jitter' m across,
a share 'skip' left out, 'scale' [lo, hi], 'species' (its pieces, flat-topped at 'top' m), each top 'above' [lo, hi] m over
the water (or 6 cm over the ground, if higher); the kit's copies of the kinds in 'drop' within 'width' of the line dropped.
The old causeway at the ford (src/world/zones/lowford.ts: 18 kit rocks at scale 0.34 x 0.2, 2.2 m apart, two rows).
E5b: 'drift' m each row weaves across (a slow wave, 'drift_len' m long), 'row_skip' a share left out per row (overrides 'skip'; a sparse middle row:
the stones between the outer two, one braided path), 'dry' none where the bed is over the water + dry m, 'step_var' each step's stray (0.35: 0.65-1.35 of 'step'),
'clear' m the least gap between two stones' rims (about 0.35 m a unit of scale from the middle) (CAUSEWAY_STATS=1 prints each stone).
'stagger' each row starts that share of a step after the one before (0.5: the rows alternate, a zigzag, one path), 'drift_shared' the
share of the drift the whole path's (its rows weave together).

C03 env fix: 'tilt' [lo, hi] deg each stone leans, 'low' a share standing only 'low_above' [lo, hi] m proud (r2: sunk 10-14 cm under, a stone seen through the water: none a pale sliver at the surface, none under the foam's depth); heights 7-28 cm, sizes 1:2.5, so no ruler row from a camera at the water.

grass._doc_lf5p: lf5p (judge lf4 #9, #7): a dry straw-tipped second kind in patches (dry_share), a value spread (val_spread); by dawn the lows' cool tint mostly gone (day_cool) and the sun warmer on the blades (sun_body .86 to .78 blue)
grass._doc: lf3b (judge lf2 #4, the clumps one stamp on an even grid): Low Ford's meadow as the shared one, its clumps in clusters with ground between, a wider size spread, varied lean, trodden bare patches (grass_own.gdshader cluster..trod; the same instances and draws)

ground._doc: lf3b (judge lf2 #3, the ruts straight near-black trenches beside a pale kerb): terrain.gdshader values over Ground.cs's defaults for this zone: shallower, lighter ruts, eased edges, broken along; the centre strip barely lifted
ground._doc_lf4v: lf4 V: the pale kerb was the centre strip's grass layer (wd cut 45%), the trench the ruts beside it; crown_grass .15 keeps the strip earth; pud_night .7: rut puddles dark and muddy by night, not sky-white
ground._doc_lf5p: lf5p (judge lf4 #1, #2: the puddles black holes; the wood road murky): the night puddle wet mud (pud_mud), the sky kept in a rim band inside its edge (pud_sheen); bare earth a notch lighter by night (night_dew .35 to .2)
ground._doc_e8r2: E8 later r2 (judge e21f1 #1: the drums stood in a band of rust, the setts' mud warm and lost stone by stone, ending dead at the grass): no setts mud here; the foot of what stands damp instead (terrain.gdshader foot_damp, out to foot_w m, onto the earth too)
ground._doc_e8r2_camp: E8 later r2 (judge e21f1 #4): a burnt disc round the camp fire 1.6 times its ring (camp_scorch, scorch_r m) flecked with ash, the earth between it and the logs trodden lighter (trample), the footpaths (ground_paths) path_hw m to their edge and path_lift lighter
ground._doc_e22r1c: Env 22 r1c (triage judge: diagonal seams across the Watch-post's floor and the gate's apron; the floor pristine): every setts here is a plaza (setts_plaza 1.5 m: one course direction, no ridge lane; GroundPaint.MakeNear); a ruin's floor (setts_wild: grass and moss in the joints in the open, setts_kerb 0: the ragged broken edge, no laid kerb); the gate's way below (setts_ways)

_doc_e8r3: E8 later r3 (judge e21r2): the foot damp narrower (foot_w .27: 20-35 px at the gate), the scorch out past the ring (scorch_r 1.5: at 1 it hid under the stones and ash), the paths wider (path_hw .3)
_doc_ground_paths: E8 later r2: Low Ford's footpaths, polylines of [x, z] (terrain.gdshader path_seg via FloraSpecies.PathsFor; tools/assets/lowford_camp_paint.py wears the same lines into splat.png so no grass grows on them): the camp east to the road by the post lantern (round the long log's south end), south-west past the bedroll, north between the logs into the wood
_doc_setts_ways: Env 22 r1c: the worn lane down the gate's apron, the road's line into the gate (FloraSpecies.SettsWaysFor; GroundPaint.MakeNear's lane, B of the near map)
